mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and decreasing real GDP (GDPC1) signals a mismatch between economic growth and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and GDPC1 decreases and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
